    Description

    The HEAD Extreme Pro 2026 is engineered for aggressive players who dominate through power and precision. This diamond-shaped racket combines cutting-edge technologies to maximise force on smashes, viboras, and attacking shots.

    Auxetic 2.0 core technology delivers exceptional power and impact feel, while Power Foam responds instantly on fast swings to amplify ball output. The carbon frame construction ensures stiffness for explosive overhead transfers, and the expanded drilling pattern widens the sweet spot for more consistent power on off-center strikes.

    Rough surface texture grips the ball for enhanced spin control, giving you command over your aggressive game. The high balance point adds leverage on attacking shots, enabling greater racket head speed through the hitting zone. Soft Cap+ features an exchangeable cord system, allowing you to tailor your string setup to your playing style.

    As the heaviest racket in the Extreme range, it rewards powerful players with the technique to exploit its weight for net dominance and point-finishing precision from anywhere on the court.

    Product details

    Weight 370 grams
    Head Shape Diamond
    Balance Head Heavy
    Face Texture Textured
    Racket Cover Not Included

    Customer collection - FREE collection from our Derbyshire showroom Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm. (Orders of in stock items will be ready for collection 30 minutes after order is placed)

    Orders £40 or over - FREE standard delivery (2-3 working days)

    UK next working day £9.99 – order by 3pm Monday to Friday. Please note that orders placed before 3pm on Friday will be delivered on MONDAY as this is a next working day service. We also offer Saturday delivery. Please note excludes bank holidays. 

    Northern Ireland, North Scotland and Offshore Islands, Jersey and Guernsey, Remote postcodes - £5.00

    Eire - £10.00

    UK Saturday delivery £13.50 - order by 3pm Friday

    Orders placed before 3pm will be despatched same day where possible and most items will be despatched within 24 hours.
